FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date = '2026-10-15'

SELECT 
  MIN(calendar_date) as earliest_date,
  MAX(calendar_date) as latest_date,
  COUNT(*) as total_rows
FROM dim_date

SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM dim_date
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND s.store_id = 107
  AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'

SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
  AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND s.store_id = 107
  AND p.subcategory = 'Cleaning Products'
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
